title: Phillis Wheatley
summary: Born in West Africa around 1753 and brought to Boston as an enslaved child in 1761, Phillis Wheatley was taught to read and write in the household of John and Susanna Wheatley. Her first published poem appeared in 1767, and her Poems on Various Subjects, Religious and Moral, published in London in 1773, is the first known book of poetry by a Black woman. She was freed after returning to Boston and died in December 1784.

uncertainty.note: The Massachusetts Historical Society gives birth in West Africa as about 1753 and arrival in Boston on 11 July 1761; the Poetry Foundation dates her purchase to August 1761. Both give death in 1784 (December per the Society).
